overall: The AG found the Board's 2021 vote creating an ARPA working group with named members made it a subcommittee subject to the Open Meeting Law, which failed to comply; no further remedial action was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board created a subcommittee to make recommendations on ARPA spending; the Board said it only had officials gathering requests, not a subcommittee.
